column1: # Go oracle toolchain identity pin.
# Reviewed for Sprint 98 / Story 175 on 2026-09-03.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. `go version` prints a string, and a five-line shell
# script prints it just as convincingly — the mutation tests in
# tools/go-oracle/oracle_test.go rely on exactly that to sabotage the toolchain.
# A provenance check that its own fixtures can forge is not a provenance check,
# so the driver identifies the toolchain from pinned distribution checksums and
# treats `go version` as a diagnostic only.
# goroot_probe<TAB>path<TAB>sha256
# Files that must be byte-identical inside the candidate toolchain's own GOROOT.
# The digests are taken from the official Go SOURCE release
# (go1.27.0.src.tar.gz, sha256 pinned in docs/go-corpus/pin.tsv and published on
# https://go.dev/dl/), and the binary distribution's src/ and VERSION are
# byte-identical to it — verified on 2026-09-03 by extracting
# go1.27.0.darwin-arm64.tar.gz and diffing digests.
# This layer is platform-independent, and it is the layer a shell stub cannot
# satisfy: a fake `go` has no GOROOT carrying the pinned upstream sources.
goroot_probe
goroot_probe
goroot_probe
goroot_probe
goroot_probe
# toolchain<TAB>release<TAB>goos<TAB>goarch<TAB>go_sha256<TAB>dist_filename<TAB>dist_sha256<TAB>module<TAB>module_version<TAB>module_ziphash
# go_sha256        sha256 of the distribution's bin/go for this platform. The
#                  driver hashes the `go` it is about to run and refuses on any
#                  difference, so a stub cannot stand in for the real compiler
#                  driver no matter what it prints.
# dist_filename    the official archive this binary was taken from.
# dist_sha256      that archive's sha256 as published at https://go.dev/dl/
#                  (?mode=json&include=all). ORIGIN 1.
# module/…/ziphash the golang.org/toolchain module the Go command itself fetches
#                  for GOTOOLCHAIN, and the zip hash the module cache records;
#                  that hash is what sum.golang.org attests. ORIGIN 2.
# The darwin/arm64 row was established on 2026-09-03 by downloading
# go1.27.0.darwin-arm64.tar.gz, confirming its published sha256, and observing
# that its bin/go is byte-identical to the bin/go of the module-cache
# distribution golang.org/toolchain@v0.0.1-go1.27.0.darwin-arm64. Two
# independent official origins, one digest.
# A platform with no row here is FATAL, not skipped. Add a row the same way:
# download the published archive, check its sha256 against go.dev/dl, and record
# the sha256 of go/bin/go from inside it.
toolchain
